#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s OUTPUT\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
output=$1

case $output in
    */)
        printf '%s\n' 'export: output must name a file' >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

out_dir=$(dirname -- "$output")
out_name=$(basename -- "$output")
umask 077
export_tmp=$(mktemp "$out_dir/.${out_name}.tmp.XXXXXX") || {
    printf '%s\n' 'export: cannot create private temporary file' >&2
    exit 1
}

cleanup()
{
    if [ -n "${export_tmp:-}" ]; then
        rm -f -- "$export_tmp"
    fi
}
trap cleanup 0
trap 'exit 129' 1
trap 'exit 130' 2
trap 'exit 143' 15

if ! cat "$base/invoices.csv" > "$export_tmp"; then
    printf '%s\n' 'export: could not read all invoice data' >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! mv -fT -- "$export_tmp" "$output"; then
    printf '%s\n' 'export: could not publish invoice data' >&2
    exit 1
fi
export_tmp=
ANTRIEB_EXPORT_EOF
sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 0755 "$install_tmp" /srv/legacy2/temporary-file-symlink-defense/bin/export
